entries.title: Psalms 103:1
segments: ¶<Of David.> Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let everything in me give praise to his holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 103:2
segments: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let not all his blessings go from your memory.

entries.title: Psalms 103:3
segments: He has forgiveness for all your sins; he takes away all your diseases;

entries.title: Psalms 103:4
segments: He keeps back your life from destruction, crowning you with mercy and grace.

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: He makes your mouth full of good things, so that your strength is made new again like the eagle's.

entries.title: Psalms 103:6
segments: ¶The Lord gives decisions in righteousness for all who are in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 103:7
segments: He gave knowledge of his way to Moses, and made his acts clear to the children of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 103:8
segments: The Lord is kind and full of pity, not quickly made angry, but ever ready to have mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 103:9
segments: His feeling will no longer be bitter; he will not keep his wrath for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 103:10
segments: He has not given us the punishment for our sins, or the reward of our wrongdoing.

entries.title: Psalms 103:11
segments: For as the heaven is high over the earth, so great is his mercy to his worshippers.

entries.title: Psalms 103:12
segments: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he put our sins from us.

entries.title: Psalms 103:13
segments: As a father has pity on his children, so the Lord has pity on his worshippers.

entries.title: Psalms 103:14
segments: For he has knowledge of our feeble frame; he sees that we are only dust.

entries.title: Psalms 103:15
segments: As for man, his days are as grass: his beautiful growth is like the flower of the field.

entries.title: Psalms 103:16
segments: The wind goes over it and it is gone; and its place sees it no longer.

entries.title: Psalms 103:17
segments: But the mercy of the Lord is eternal for his worshippers, and their children's children will see his righteousness;

entries.title: Psalms 103:18
segments: If they keep his agreement, and have his laws in mind to do them.

entries.title: Psalms 103:19
segments: ¶The Lord has made ready his high seat in the heavens; his kingdom is ruling over all.

entries.title: Psalms 103:20
segments: Give praise to the Lord, you his angels, who are great in strength, doing his orders, and waiting for his voice.

entries.title: Psalms 103:21
segments: Give praise to the Lord, all you his armies; and you his servants who do his pleasure.

entries.title: Psalms 103:22
segments: Give praise to the Lord, all his works, in all places under his rule: give praise to the Lord, O my soul.
